background.summary: Purchase requests are currently handled through email, spreadsheets, and offline signatures. Requesters cannot see approval status, approvers lack one task queue, and finance has difficulty tracing approval evidence during audits.
background.objective: Create a standardized online approval workflow for purchase requests, improve approval transparency, reduce cycle time, and preserve full audit history.

in_scope: Multi-level approval routing by amount and department
Approver task queue and process history
Return, withdraw, reject, and resubmit handling

target_users: Requester: submits purchase requests and tracks progress
Finance reviewer: checks budget and account rules
core_scenarios: A requester submits a purchase request and attaches quotation evidence.
The system routes the request to department and finance approvers based on amount.
An approver returns the request with comments and the requester resubmits it.
Finance exports approval history during monthly audit review.

business_rules: Only authorized roles can view scoped data and perform sensitive actions.
Core business actions must keep an audit trail.
Exported data must follow the same filters and permission scope as the page.
Data refresh status and calculation definitions must be visible to users.

interaction_flow: A requester submits a purchase request and attaches quotation evidence.
The system routes the request to department and finance approvers based on amount.
An approver returns the request with comments and the requester resubmits it.
Finance exports approval history during monthly audit review.

risks_and_notes: Metric ownership and data definitions must be confirmed.

acceptance_criteria: The example scope can be generated into PRD and design documents.
Users can revise the seeded requirement through chat messages.
Main roles, flows, data, permissions, and acceptance criteria are represented.
